entry.title: Zoning Board of Appeals: the meeting of 26 August 2026 — recording, transcript and our minutes
entry.summary: ZBA approved a used-car dealership at 149 Summer Street, capped at 24 cars with no customer repairs. The recording is on the town’s channel (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=62qwUKHEBro), its captions are searchable, and our minutes are written from them; the video at its timestamp is the record.
